about: The conversation-title question of the mail pass (fm_agent::titles), 2026-10-19. Each case names the mailbox's owner (`me`), the person the title must name (`name`, matched loosely), and words of which the description must contain at least one (`about_any`, lower case). Synthetic threads; every role is stated in the emails.
